# Muslim Abaya

> Muslim Abaya (muslimabaya.com) is an online store in Bangladesh selling modest fashion: abayas, two-piece dresses, kurtis, kaftans, hijabs, cover-ups, embroidery and karchupi wear, plus men's panjabi. Orders are placed online with cash on delivery nationwide.

Prices, stock and product details change often; use the collection pages below for current information.

## Shop collections

- [Home](https://muslimabaya.com/): featured products from every collection
- [All categories](https://muslimabaya.com/category): overview of every collection
- [Abaya](https://muslimabaya.com/abaya): abaya collection
- [Premium two-piece](https://muslimabaya.com/premium-two-piece): two-piece dresses and sets
- [Cover up](https://muslimabaya.com/cover-up): modest cover-up collection
- [Tops and kurti](https://muslimabaya.com/tops-kurti): tops and kurtis
- [Embroidery](https://muslimabaya.com/embroidery): embroidery abayas and dresses
- [Karchupi](https://muslimabaya.com/karchupi): karchupi collection
- [Kaftan](https://muslimabaya.com/kaftan): kaftan collection
- [Hijab](https://muslimabaya.com/hijab): hijab collection
- [Panjabi](https://muslimabaya.com/panjabi): men's panjabi
- [Product videos](https://muslimabaya.com/video): videos of the dresses
